en.title: The Calm Sea and the Voyage Log of Undelivered Letters
en.premise: One day, I discover a bundle of undeliverable letters tucked away in an old bag. They are messages addressed to the residents of a "Forgotten Village," a place said to have vanished from every map. Boarding a small hot-air balloon, I set out on a journey to trace the fate of those letters. Awaiting me are heartwarming encounters with new friends and the delicious flavors of lands I've never seen before.

zh.title: 凪之海与未能送达的信件航海日誌
zh.premise: 某一天，我在一只旧皮包里发现了一叠“因地址不明而未能送达的信件”。那是写给据说曾从地图上消失的“被遗忘之村”居民们的信。于是，我乘坐着一只小气球，踏上了追寻信件主人们行踪的旅程。在旅途中，与人们之间温暖人心的交流，以及从未见过的异乡美食，正等待着我。
